items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I had Ben Webster, Benny Carter, Alfred Newman... You did all those nice things with Ben and Benny Carter and Sweets... I was on all those records.

ctx.x: Celeste. He'd say, "You're the greatest celeste player in the world. Drink this. Now go out there and play that goddamn thing, and don't give me any shit." And I'd go out there and I'd play it! Then he'd stop me, TIP-TIP-TIP, everybody would shut up. He would say, "See, I told you."
Pappy. Bad cat. He was a (?). Except that he wasn't Czechoslovakian. He was a Jewish master. And I loved him dearly, in a fatherly way. Because I never had a father!
